slug: 2025-10-03 Zambia plans domestic digital ID development with help from international partners

facts.fact: Zambia's Ministry of Home Affairs is launching the Zambia Refugee and Host Communities Project, funded with $30 million by the World Bank with UNHCR support, under which biometric national registration cards will be issued to refugees and former refugees.
